subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 6: English in action (saying the time)
outcomes: I can say the time with o'clock, half past, quarter past and quarter to.
I can ask and answer What time is it?
I can act out a short dialogue about time.

tf.s: When the minute hand is on 12, we say o'clock.
tf.why: Yes! 12 on the minute hand means o'clock.

tf.s: When the minute hand is on 6, we say quarter past.
tf.why: Minute hand on 6 means half past.

tf.s: When the minute hand is on 3, we say quarter past.
tf.why: Well done! On 3 is quarter past.

tf.s: When the minute hand is on 9, we say quarter to.
Quarter past eight is earlier than quarter to eight.
tf.why: Quarter to eight comes first, then eight o'clock, then quarter past eight.

tf.s: In the dialogue, they have English at quarter past eight.
tf.why: Yes! We have English at quarter past eight.

tf.s: Half past six comes after quarter past six.
tf.why: Quarter past six, then half past six.

tf.s: Quarter to seven comes before half past six.
tf.why: Half past six comes first, then quarter to seven.

tf.s: We ask What time is it? to know the time.
tf.why: That is the question for the time.

tf.s: In the second dialogue, it is time for breakfast.
tf.why: It's seven o'clock and it's time for dinner.

boxes.q: Minute hand on 12, hour hand on 4. What time is it?
Complete: It's quarter ___ eight. (minute hand on 9)
Complete: It's half past ___. (hour hand between 6 and 7)
boxes.why: Between 6 and 7 with the minute hand on 6 is half past six.

boxes.q: Minute hand on 3, hour hand just after 9.
Which question asks about the time?
boxes.why: We ask What time is it?

boxes.q: What time do they have English?
boxes.why: They have English at quarter past eight.

boxes.q: Why do they say Let's hurry?
boxes.why: English is starting, so they hurry.

boxes.q: In the second dialogue, what time is it?

boxes.why: Quarter to eight is before eight o'clock.

boxes.q: Where is the minute hand at half past one?
boxes.why: Half past means the minute hand is on 6.

mcq.q: What do we say when the minute hand is on 6?
Which question is from the dialogue?
o: What time do we have English?
When do you go to bed?
How many desks can you see?
mcq.why: They ask What time do we have English?

mcq.q: What is it time for in the second dialogue?
What do they say when they are late?
mcq.why: They say Oh, no! and Let's hurry!

mcq.q: The minute hand is on 9 and the hour hand is just before 3. What time is it?
mcq.why: On 9 is quarter to, and the next hour is three.

mcq.q: Make a dialogue line: have breakfast / quarter to six.
o: We have breakfast at quarter to six.
We have breakfast in quarter to six.
We have breakfast at six to quarter.
mcq.why: We use at with a time.

mcq.q: The minute hand is on 3 and the hour hand is just after 10. What time is it?
Which list is in the right order, from early to late?
o: six o'clock, quarter past six, half past six, quarter to seven
half past six, six o'clock, quarter to seven, quarter past six
quarter to seven, half past six, quarter past six, six o'clock
quarter past six, six o'clock, half past six, quarter to seven

mcq.q: English is at quarter past eight. It is quarter past eight now. What do you say?
o: Oh, no! It's time for English! Let's hurry!
We go to bed at night.
mcq.why: It is time for English, so we hurry.

mcq.q: Quarter to seven is the same as ...
mcq.why: Quarter to means 15 minutes before the hour.
